subject: Mathematics
notice: Demo subset. Summaries and teaching points are paraphrased for this product and are not VCAA text. Check every content description code against the VCAA site before using this data with customers.

items.summary: Add and subtract two- and three-digit numbers using place value, partitioning and regrouping, and check answers with estimation.
teaching_points: Partition numbers into hundreds, tens and ones
Show regrouping on a place value chart
Estimate first, then check the exact answer

items.summary: Recall and use multiplication facts for 2, 3, 4, 5 and 10 and the related division facts.
teaching_points: Use arrays and skip counting
Connect multiplication and division as inverse operations
Use doubling to move from 2s to 4s

items.topic: Measuring length in centimetres and metres
items.summary: Measure and compare lengths using metres and centimetres and convert between them in simple cases.
teaching_points: 1 metre is 100 centimetres
Line up the zero mark on a ruler
Choose a sensible unit for the object

items.summary: Find and represent equivalent fractions with denominators of 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 8, 10 and 12 using models and number lines.
teaching_points: Multiply numerator and denominator by the same number
Show equivalence on parallel number lines
Compare fractions by converting to a common denominator

items.summary: Multiply two- and three-digit numbers by one-digit numbers using place value and the distributive property.
teaching_points: Split the larger number into tens and ones
Use an area model
Estimate to check reasonableness

items.summary: Find the perimeter of rectangles and estimate and compare areas by counting square units.
teaching_points: Perimeter is the distance around the shape
Area counts unit squares inside the shape
Opposite sides of a rectangle are equal

items.topic: Adding and subtracting fractions with the same denominator
items.summary: Add and subtract fractions with the same denominator, including mixed numbers, using models and number lines.
teaching_points: Only the numerators change when denominators match
Convert improper fractions to mixed numbers
Model the operation on a number line

items.summary: Read, write, order and round decimals to thousandths and connect them to fractions with denominators of 10, 100 and 1000.
teaching_points: Extend the place value chart to thousandths
Compare decimals digit by digit from the left
Rounding to the nearest tenth or hundredth

items.summary: Calculate the area and perimeter of rectangles using formulas and solve practical problems with them.
teaching_points: Area = length x width
Perimeter = 2 x (length + width)
Always include square units for area

items.summary: Construct and interpret column graphs from collected data and describe what the data shows.
teaching_points: Read values carefully from the scale
Compare categories using differences
Find the total and the most common category

items.topic: Adding and subtracting fractions with related denominators
items.summary: Add and subtract fractions where one denominator is a multiple of the other, and solve problems involving these fractions.
teaching_points: Rename one fraction so the denominators match
Simplify the answer
Check with a fraction wall or number line

items.summary: Find simple percentages of quantities, such as 10%, 25% and 50%, and connect percentages to fractions and decimals.
teaching_points: Percent means out of 100
10% is one tenth, 25% is one quarter
Build harder percentages from 10% and 5%

items.summary: Locate and order positive and negative integers on a number line and use them in everyday contexts such as temperature.
teaching_points: Numbers left of zero are negative
Further left means smaller
Use temperature and sea level as contexts

items.summary: Calculate the mean of a small data set and compare data sets using the mean and the range.
teaching_points: Mean = total divided by number of values
Range = largest minus smallest
Check the mean sits between the smallest and largest values
